_description: Fitted coefficients — output of the fitting pipeline (tools/fit/). Regenerated by scripts, not edited manually.

MOON_CORRECTION_RESIDUAL._comment: D5 derived optics: the framework-native runtime subtracts the ANALYTIC annual aberration (from speedOfLight + Sun velocity); this residual = MOON_CORRECTION minus the aberration projection (tools/explore/derive-moon-correction-content.js). Dominated by the one genuinely non-optical term raCosMp (5.1 arcsec, Meeus-vs-DE440 truncation class); everything aberration-shaped cancels. Legacy MOON_CORRECTION above stays for the pure-Meeus A/B mode.

CARDINAL_POINT_DERIVED.note: Runtime must use these verbatim — see plan §10c / §10e-quinquies

CARDINAL_POINT_JOINT_TERMS.note: phase = order*lambda_X - 2*pi*div*cycles, self-corrected at 2000; counter-rotating — see plan §10g
